rows.grounds: compound adverb indicating placement at both extremities

items.question: Where should the whole name and praṇava be written in the mantra construction?
premises: Whole name occupies beginning and end.
items.inference: Thus the mantra is framed by the whole name with praṇava appended.
uncertainties: ādyante parsing as locative dual or compound adverb remains unresolved.
items.plain_english: At beginning and end [write] the whole name; then write praṇava.
